run_sync_transcription: run synchronous audio transcription using the OpenAI-compatible vLLM API with repetition penalty
run_stream_transcription_openai: run asynchronous streaming audio transcription using the OpenAI Python SDK against the vLLM server
run_stream_transcription_raw: run streaming audio transcription using raw HTTP requests and server-sent events to the vLLM API
run_transcription_with_custom_audio: run audio transcription with a custom audio file path and repetition penalty via CLI arguments
run_transcription_with_default_audio: run audio transcription using built-in vLLM AudioAsset samples like mary_had_lamb and winning_call
